inactionThreat.resultDescription: The fishing aficionados are tormented by the proximity of all that watery expanse, with all kinds of unknown fish they cannot catch.

A true sea giant decided to respond in kind and attack the fishermen. Luckily, they managed to detect the attack in advance and escape the leviathan's hungry belly. Despite the scare, they do not seem to be discouraged from trying fishing in local waters again, already boasting of having caught quite a few impressive specimens.

actions.description: Provide the fishermen with everything they need to catch various specimens from local shoals and schools.

nodes.name: Plant Diseases
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: Specific building, Universum, Plantation, Farm
nodes.spawnConditions: Specific building, Universum, Plantation, Farm
nodes.eventDescription: The crew members working with the crops report that an unknown affliction is targeting the plants on the ship. Strange blue lines, like varicose veins, spread on the stalks, leaves, and roots. The afflicted plants continue to grow and develop as usual, but as they grow in size, those alien streaks stretch and spread further. Glowing. Pulsating. Upon examination, it appears to be a local parasitic lifeform that lives in the plants' endodermis. It is highly toxic and therefore unfit for consumption.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: It appears that some of the infected crops have wound up in the kitchen. Stomach aches, fever, and diarrhea are now the common afflictions among the crew.

penalties.name: Weakened Immunity I
penalties.comments: Affected cremember's Immunity is reduced by 40% (rounded up)

penalties.name: Weakened Health II
penalties.comments: The crew's HP maximum is reduced by a percentile. The missing amount of health is reduced first.

actions.description: The parasite that afflicts our plants is highly toxic. However, it is possible to reverse its fatal effects and use it for medical purposes.
actions.resultDescription: Your scientists work hard to turn the whole crisis upside down: from poison to cure. Eventually, they bring the good news: they have managed to extract the parasitic fluid from the plants and use it to create a batch of custom MedGel.

actions.description: The scientists are confident they can cure the affliction.
actions.resultDescription: Your scientists work hard on finding a way to neutralize the parasite's toxicity. Eventually, they bring the good news and inform you that, despite the lingering visual effects, the recently afflicted crops are fit for consumption.

actions.description: The compromised plant life is not suitable for consumption, but it can be processed into Chemical Fuel.
actions.resultDescription: The order is out, and the crew cuts down the blue-striped plants and hauls them to a workshop where they recycle them into Chemical Fuel.

 Your people are loving the new menu.

nodes.name: Infestation
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: Distance from island less than 1, any building
nodes.spawnConditions: Distance from island less than 1, any building
nodes.eventDescription:
A gnarly, bulbous, black formation of alien origin appears in one of the buildings. The crew hears a low buzzing noise from inside. 
 The screams of the crew precede their appearance, running in panic from the building. The last man to get out closes the door and initiates a lockdown. When asked what happened, the crew tells about a strange black formation that appeared on the ceiling this morning. A gnarly, bulbous, tar-colored rock with porous walls spread and took over the facility, with a low buzzing noise humming inside. However, the mystery of that noise was short-lived. As the crew gaped at this unusual intrusion into their workspace, a bunch of amber-colored insects crawled out of that rock, spread their wings, and swooped toward the crew in what seemed to be a hostile maneuver.
The crew did not wait to find out and fled.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription:
The insects manage to find their way out of the locked-down building and attack the crew. Luckily, their stings cannot penetrate the safety suits and present no threat. A small number of wasps that have escaped are soon found and killed.
 It is not so easy to do with those in the nest inside the facility. As a result, the future shifts working there should spend some of their time fighting off the annoying insects.

penalties.name: Productivity Slowdown III
penalties.comments: Buildings' or crew's  productivity is reduced by 80 for duration fo effect.

penalties.name: Corrosive Mold
penalties.comments: Each hour, affected building loses 5 points of Integrity.

actions.description: Create a chemical poison and kill the uninvited guests.
actions.resultDescription:
You send a group equipped with improvised spraying devices to disperse the chemical poison. It works like a charm, quickly killing the insects.
 After that, all that is left to be done is to remove the nest formation.

rewards.name: Boosted Productivity II
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's productivity is increased by 50 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: Burn the nest, ignoring all the damage done to the building in the process.
actions.resultDescription: You send a group equipped with improvised flamethrowers to shoot fire at the insects and their nest. As expected, these bugs are no more resistant to fire than their distant relatives back on Earth.  Unfortunately, during this mission, the building itself caught fire. And so, after the fight against insects was over, the fight against fire began.

rewards.name: Boosted Productivity II
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's productivity is increased by 50 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: Study the unexpected stowaways and learn more about the local fauna.
actions.resultDescription: Scientists take this as an opportunity to learn more about the local fauna. Their first discovery is that their stings present no threat to the crew wearing safety suits.  The work at the facility is soon renewed. However, the productivity is far from the best, as the shifts have to fight off the annoying wasps while working, all while being documented by their colleagues.

rewards.name: Boosted Productivity I
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's productivity is increased by 25 for duration fo effect.

nodes.name: Special Training
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: in the open sea, Game stage 2 or more, Behemoth
nodes.spawnConditions: in the open sea, Game stage 2 or more, Behemoth
nodes.eventDescription:
Orest Demchuck, Security Force Commanding Officer, wants to lead a special training course on survival for the crew.
Your head of scouts is adamant about the necessity of such training. "Do I really need to explain the benefits of survival skills? We are on an alien planet with a thousand elaborate ways to kill us. How to defend oneself, how to patch up your wounded crew member, how to make fire out of mud and sticks, how to navigate by stars, how to… I mean, the list can go on. All these how-tos can tip the scales between life and death in the former's favor. And give us another day to make something out of the situation we are in."

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The training course remains a missed opportunity.

actions.description: Allow Orest to organize a self-defense training course.
actions.resultDescription: The crew undergoes a series of vigorous exercises: close combat, accuracy shooting, obstacle course traversal, and many others. The muscles throb and ache, making the next day of work a more tiring experience, but the skills learned and the knowledge gained are invaluable.

actions.description: Every crew member must know how to provide first aid.
actions.resultDescription: The crew learns several applications of MedGel and the basics of first aid. How to stop bleeding, what to do when a heart stops, and even less extreme situations, like what to do when someone faints, are given much-needed time, so that the crew can be ready for any exigency.

rewards.name: Boosted Health I
rewards.comments: The crew's HP maximum is increased by a percentile. The extra HP max comes filled with extra health.

actions.description: It is important to know how to navigate freighters, recon crafts, and the ship itself.
actions.resultDescription: The crew learns how to navigate various types of available vessels and how to interpret sensor readings to avoid unwanted collisions on the island-riddled planet.

actions.description: If stranded on the island, people should know how to craft basics, how to use available tools, and how to fix broken equipment.
actions.resultDescription: Orest invites Tuuli, the Chief Engineer, to give a masterclass on survival crafting. It starts with basics, such as making a lean-to and starting a fire, and then the training gets progressively more complicated as Tuuli forces crew members to disassemble various tools and gadgets to learn how to repair them.

rewards.name: Boosted Productivity I
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's productivity is increased by 25 for duration fo effect.

nodes.name: Vaccine
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: More than 5 ill crew members, Behemoth
nodes.spawnConditions: More than 5 ill crew members, Behemoth
nodes.eventDescription:
The Medbay has been developing a special vaccine meant to boost the crew's immunity to the local pathogens.
 The crew of Behemoth is alien to this planet, and the risk of someone catching some indigenous virus or bacteria is always present. Surely, the crew follows a set of strict rules and precautions to reduce the chance of contracting a deadly strain, but it would be much better for the crew to have resistance to the unwanted gifts of this planet. To create a vaccine, the doctors need to study one of the following subjects extensively.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: You ignored requests from the team. The “Nocebo effect” caused by continuous stress among team members regarding potential alien sickness actually worsened their natural resistance.

actions.description: The doctors need a lot of Prebiotic Matter to have enough pathogenic test subjects for their research on the vaccine.
actions.resultDescription: The doctors announce a breakthrough in their attempt to develop a vaccine. They advise every crew member to get a shot immediately to reduce the risk of contracting local diseases.

rewards.name: Boosted Immunity II
rewards.comments: Affected cremember's Immunity is Increased by 100% (rounded up)

actions.description: The researches want to study the Krill, believing them to be perfect carriers of pathogens.
actions.resultDescription: The doctors do not manage to develop vaccine, however, the knowledge they gathered through research can be valuable in deepening comprehension of Keeling-IV ecosystems.

actions.description: The pathogens can be found in the Algae. The doctors need plenty of test subjects for their work on the vaccine.
actions.resultDescription: The doctors announce a breakthrough in their attempt to develop a vaccine. They advise every crew member to get a shot immediately to reduce the risk of contracting local diseases.

nodes.name: Ghost
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: Game stage 3 or more, morale less then 50, Behemoth
nodes.spawnConditions: Game stage 3 or more, morale less then 50, Behemoth
nodes.eventDescription:
A crew member tried to jump over the safety rail and disappear into the water. 
 A severely depressed individual, who attempted a one-way dive into the water, has been admitted to the health center. At first, the man is taciturn when questioned about his well-being. Later, he expresses his unwillingness to continue with this 'farce.' "It is all pointless," he says. "He is right. The sooner it ends, the better." He does not explain who is right...
This man is not alone in his misery. Lately, the halls are full of dark, despondent whispers. And there seems to be someone responsible for the spread of this despair... You hear rumors of a ghost, of a lonely voice echoing in the halls.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Catastrophic failure occurs due to delay.

actions.description: Provide an online program for monitoring emotional well-being and offering support to maintain the crew's morale.
actions.resultDescription: The support program proved to be efficient. With the help of deep meditation, psychological guidance, and cutting edge technology, people realized that ghosts only exist in the eye of an exhausted mind and let go of those irrational fears.

rewards.name: Morale Boost III
rewards.comments: The crewmember's morale is increased by 30 for that duration (can surpass 100)

actions.description: Distribute sedatives to the team to help them cope with irrational fears. This might have negative impact on their productivity.
actions.resultDescription: The sedatives improve the overall situation, though not without several side effects (apathy, lack of energy, loss of appetite, and others) that unfortunately affect general productivity.

rewards.name: Morale Stasis
rewards.comments: Morale value is frozen at the level it was when status effect has started. This effect can be overridden by bonus and debuff to morale effects.

rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's  productivity is reduced by 20 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: Use trained personnel and professional equipment to perform deep scanning of the hallways and interior infrastructure.
actions.resultDescription: There is, indeed, a disembodied voice that haunts the halls of the ship. An unsanctioned AI Core was installed within the ship's systems and made invisible even to Mnemosyne. When it happened, or who is responsible for this crime, remains unanswered. But this AI agent is the one spreading disturbing ideas and sowing seeds of doubt in the minds of your crew.  The AI core is removed. And the mysterious ghost is no more.

nodes.eventDescription: Safety Report:      "In an attempt to shoot a low-budget horror video, a crew member duct-taped long blades to a cleaning robot's frame. I know, I know, it gets better: the robot activated mid-filming and caused quite a panic among the wannabe filmmakers. And now we have an unidentified cleaning robot with knives for cleaning tools.       I request access to the armory to dispatch this Jack the Cleaner."       From: Orest Demchuck.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Safety Report: "So, we let the bladed bot do its thing for a little too long. It eventually came way too close to stabbing one of our people—no fatalities, but it was a near miss. The panic spread fast, and the  film studio had to be shut down in record time. Lesson learned, I hope." From: Orest Demchuck.

The robot’s back to harmlessly bumping into walls, and the crew’s sense of safety has gone way up. One less horror story for now." From: Orest Demchuck.

actions.description: Send the global stop code, lock charging bays, and post manual cleanup shifts.
actions.resultDescription:
Safety report:
"Well, good news: the team managed to snag our knife-wielding cleaning robot with its batteries nearly drained! Sure, manual mopping isn’t anyone’s favorite pastime, but the chase gave everyone an unexpected show and actually boosted spirits. Crisis averted!" From: Orest Demchuck.

"Captain, I have noticed a surge in handoff errors between departments—schedule overlaps, duplicated efforts, and general confusion are emerging in the crew’s logs. It appears someone inadvertently began following an outdated handoff protocol, leading to two conflicting sets of regulations circulating at once. Unless this is resolved, our coordination will continue to unravel and productivity will decline further. I recommend swiftly standardizing procedures and clarifying protocols to restore order.
With due respect, Mnemosyne."

"Captain, no corrective action has been taken. The gaps in our procedures persist. Rather than cooperating, personnel now circumvent each other, bypassing the shared process entirely. Recovery will require considerable effort and time.
With due respect, Mnemosyne."

Following a thorough conversation with the team, we have implemented updates to all relevant procedures. This revision has resulted in an unexpected boost to overall productivity.
With due respect, Mnemosyne."

penalties.name: Productivity Slowdown II
penalties.comments: Buildings' or crew's  productivity is reduced by 40 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: Sweep with a small security detail, catalog what we find, and lock it in evidence storage with a quiet note to the team.
actions.resultDescription: The group of volunteers confiscated the entire batch without sorting individual bottles. Though frustrating for some, this decisive action prevented a crisis and kept everyone safe.

actions.description: Broadcast an amnesty notice ship-wide and set up a no-questions return desk at the nearest checkpoint.
actions.resultDescription: The crew willingly returned several bottles, and the hallucinogenic substance was discovered during a routine trade-in inspection. Thanks to their cooperation, the risky spirits were contained before causing any incidents.

actions.description: Distractions among staff affect productivity, but the substance has a positive effect on the crew's mental health.
actions.resultDescription: A warning was issued about the potential effects, allowing crew members to make informed choices. While productivity may have taken a slight dip, overall morale and mental well-being noticeably improved as trust in crew leadership grew.

rewards.name: Morale Boost II
rewards.comments: The crewmember's morale is increased by 20 for that duration (can surpass 100)

rewards.name: Productivity Slowdown I
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's  productivity is reduced by 20 for duration fo effect.

nodes.name: Stowaway Fauna
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: Distance from island less than 1, Target: Behemoth
nodes.spawnConditions: Distance from island less than 1, Target: Behemoth
nodes.eventDescription: Several specimens of the local fauna hitched a ride on one of the cargo ships and weren't discovered until they had already established a small colony in the less-visited parts of the Behemoth. They appear harmless, they're cute, and the crew loves having them around — someone started calling them Plumplins, and the name stuck.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The colony works its way into new vents and any corner nobody checks. Cleanup is no longer a quick job.

penalties.name: Waste Issues II
penalties.comments: Each affected building produces 50% more waste.

actions.description: Fence off a small habitat, run regular sanitation checks, and keep the colony under observation.
actions.resultDescription: The crew adopts the Plumplins as unofficial mascots. Spirits lift, and medbay reports a measurable boost to crew immunity. The only cost is a slight dip in productivity — people keep finding reasons to walk past the habitat.

rewards.name: Boosted Immunity I
rewards.comments: Affected cremember's Immunity is Increased by 50% (rounded up)

rewards.name: Morale Boost I
rewards.comments: The crewmember's morale is increased by 10 for that duration (can surpass 100)

rewards.name: Productivity Slowdown I
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's  productivity is reduced by 20 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: A xenofauna colony aboard is not something we can sign off on. Crate the animals carefully and keep them safe until we reach a suitable island.
actions.resultDescription: Nobody wanted to be the one who hurt them. The nest came out in one piece — lined material, scraps, and all — and went straight into a crate padded for the trip. The Plumplins moved in after it without much fuss, and the crew spent the rest of the shift checking on them.

actions.description: Nothing from this planet has been cleared for life aboard, harmless or not. Euthanize the specimens under bio-protocol and forward samples to the lab.
actions.resultDescription: The crew took it badly. Something settled over the ship afterwards that nobody puts into words. The researchers logged an anomalous organic artifact recovered from the nest, along with a strange connection to the Plumplins themselves.

nodes.name: Pest Problem
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location:
in the open sea, Specific building, Bioengineering
Workshop, Universum, Plantation, Farm
nodes.spawnConditions:
in the open sea, Specific building, Bioengineering
Workshop, Universum, Plantation, Farm
nodes.eventDescription: A unique pest problem has disrupted operations—if something resembling a shark with legs can be called a pest. The creature somehow squeezed into the food production buildings, leaving chaos and a mess in its wake. Now, it falls to the crew to devise a solution for handling this unusual intruder.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Without intervention, the legged shark continues to roam freely, creating ongoing disorder and causing mounting frustration among the crew tasked with food production. Morale takes a hit as the nuisance persists.

actions.description: Observe the locations where the creature appears most often and carefully prepare a humane trap to capture it without harm.
actions.resultDescription: The "pest" turns out to be a secret pet belonging to one of the crew. After it was finally cornered, the ambush turned into something closer to a celebration: everyone took turns getting a look at it, the owner got their share of jokes, and then the creature was quietly released.

actions.description: Closely monitor the creature’s movement patterns to determine how it enters the building and uncover its origins.
actions.resultDescription: Tailing the creature reveals its true nature — a secret pet kept by one of the crew. The owner admits what he'd been doing, and after a short goodbye the creature goes back into the wild. The patrol turns out to be a welcome break for everyone involved: a bit of movement, a bit of fresh air, and the whole group comes back looser and more awake.

actions.description: Review and strengthen the building’s security protocols, eliminating any loopholes that allowed the “shark” to gain access.
actions.resultDescription: Once new protocols are in place, the creature’s secret owner has no choice but to come forward and admit the truth. The pet is released safely into the wild. The tightened security standards prompt the crew to work diligently to adapt, boosting overall discipline and work ethic.

nodes.name: Lets Go Gambling
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: Game stage 2 or later
nodes.spawnConditions: Game stage 2 or later
nodes.eventDescription: What started as a harmless way to kill time has spiraled into a full-blown craze aboard the ship. Crew members now collect bacteria-like cultures in petri dishes and place bets on which sample will flourish first - turning the pastime into a racing league. Although the activity seems innocent enough, concerns are growing that it could easily lead to a serious accident.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: As anticipated, one of the extremophile bacteria escapes containment, rapidly corroding part of the ship’s structure. The incident serves as a costly reminder of the dangers unchecked fun can unleash.

penalties.name: Corrosive Mold
penalties.comments: Each hour, affected building loses 5 points of Integrity.

actions.description: Provide specialized equipment to ensure each “race” is safely contained, along with education on disease prevention to minimize health risks.
actions.resultDescription: With improved containment gear and briefings on the dangers of improper handling, the crew’s competitions become much safer. Not only is the risk of disease spread drastically reduced, but the heightened awareness gives everyone’s immunity a welcome boost.

actions.description: Introduce precision tools and encourage the crew to reinvent the contest, using their enthusiasm to cultivate new antibiotics instead of hazards.
actions.resultDescription: With upgraded tools and a new purpose, the crew channels their competitive energy into real research. Friendly rivalries now push them to discover promising antibiotic candidates, blending fun with meaningful contributions to shipwide health.

actions.description: Impose immediate restrictions and dismantle the competition to prevent any risk of an outbreak.
actions.resultDescription: Though some crew members are disappointed, the swift action pays off — potential threats are neutralized before they can develop, safeguarding the entire vessel from a possible epidemic. Fortunately, a few of the cell cultures are salvaged safely and can be repurposed as basic medicine, providing a small but valuable benefit to the ship’s medical reserves.

nodes.name: Birthday Party
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: In the open sea
nodes.spawnConditions: In the open sea
nodes.eventDescription: A rumor has started to circulate across the ship: Executive Officer Khalil Arida may be celebrating his birthday soon. Though he has always been guarded about such personal matters, some say the old man deserves a little festivity in his honor. Perhaps it’s time to show some appreciation — whether he admits to the occasion or not.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The supposed birthday passes with no celebration or gift. Later, word spreads that Khalil’s birthday was actually on another day. Some crew members feel a twinge of disappointment, wondering if their own special days might someday be forgotten as well, leaving the atmosphere a bit subdued.

actions.description: Invite a few crew members to help plan and organize a surprise birthday celebration for Khalil.
actions.resultDescription: The crew gathers in the R&D lab, ready with decorations and homemade treats to greet the officer. Throughout the party, Khalil appears pleasantly surprised, though a bit bewildered by all the fuss. At the end, he quietly confides that today isn’t actually his birthday. Nevertheless, the crew enjoys themselves immensely, and the shared laughter brings everyone a little closer together.

actions.description: Recruit personnel to craft a thoughtful and practical gift for Khalil — something he’d truly appreciate.
actions.resultDescription: Pooling their skills, the team assembles a fresh powercell, recalling that Khalil’s equipment has been in need of an upgrade. When the gift is presented privately, Khalil politely declines, explaining that his birthday isn’t today. Even so, the spare powercell finds a grateful home aboard the ship, proving useful for the entire crew.

nodes.name: Birds and Bees
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location:
Game stage 2 or later
at least 1 crabari crew member, in the open sea
nodes.spawnConditions:
Game stage 2 or later
at least 1 crabari crew member, in the open sea
nodes.eventDescription: A human crew member has been sharing some deep connection with Ruthless-Sky (short Ruth), a crabari hired on deck. The crewmember finds Ruth's powerful stature and kind eyes incredibly attractive, and Ruth sees crewmember's "clan" (the rest of vessel's crew) strong enough for him to be a feasible mate. Despite cultural differences between humans and crabari, they want to play wedding.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Disheartened by the lack of response from the captain, Ruthless-Sky and the unnamed crew member decided to take matters into their own hands. Under the cover of night, the pair slipped away from the ship, climbing atop a mysterious marine creature that surfaced near the hull. By morning, both were gone without a trace.  Little is known of their whereabouts, yet hope remains among the crew that, wherever they are, the unlikely couple has found happiness together.

actions.description: Organize a generous meal for the newlyweds and all interested crew, ensuring plenty of food to fuel the festivities and foster unity.
actions.resultDescription: The wedding feast turned out to be wonderfully lavish, even with limited resources. Bellies were so full by the end that several crew members vowed to start a diet immediately afterward.

rewards.name: Fasting
rewards.effect: each food charge lasts 4 hours for 24 hours
rewards.comments: The crewmember spends each food charge every 4 hours, while receiving effects of food every hour as usual.

actions.description: Create a festive atmosphere with makeshift fireworks, launching a salute to honor the union and bring a vibrant sense of celebration to the deck.
actions.resultDescription: The ceremony was simple, set amid the practical backdrop of the R&D lab, with rings fashioned from scrap metal. As the two exchanged vows and became a couple, the ship seemed just a little warmer. Word of the union spread, and sympathetic traders across the sector offered financial gifts to celebrate the new couple’s happiness.

rewards.name: Delighted Crabari Traders
rewards.comments: Buying prices are reduced by 30% (rounded up) for the trader of that Crabari.

actions.description: Bring together a few crew members for a thoughtful discussion with the couple — love is powerful, but it may be wise to consider if they’re moving too quickly.
actions.resultDescription: The candid discussion led by crew experts went smoothly. Ruth and the crew member agreed they’d jumped in too quickly and decided to remain friends — for now. As they exited, an officer swears the crew member gave Ruth a sly wink, hinting that the story might not be over just yet.

rewards.name: Morale Stasis
rewards.comments: Morale value is frozen at the level it was when status effect has started. This effect can be overridden by bonus and debuff to morale effects.

nodes.name: Energy Leaks
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: Game stage 3 or more, in the open sea, any energy building
nodes.spawnConditions: Game stage 3 or more, in the open sea, any energy building
nodes.eventDescription: We detected odd voltage spikes on the power lines, and tracing them led us to an unexpected visitor. Some kind of creature has made itself at home in the power conduits. As far as we can tell, it's eating our electricity.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Undisturbed, the creature resumed drawing energy from the source. The crew were not impressed by their commander's helplessness.

actions.description: To get rid of the creature, we need to be creative. If it feeds on energy, we'll build a lure and draw it back into the ocean. There's some risk involved, but we'll manage.
actions.resultDescription: The operation was largely a success. The creature pounced on the bait without hesitation. That said, a few crew members were injured while installing the lure and in the aftermath. Still, it was spectacular, so morale is up.

actions.description: We cannot allow this creature to threaten the crew and cripple our power supply. Prepare the team to eliminate it.
actions.resultDescription: After the creature was attacked, it emitted a a powerful signal. It appears to have been a call for help, so be ready for a potential threat from the depths.

actions.description: It is too risky to interact with the creature directly. Send researchers with the right gear to study it from a safe distance.
actions.resultDescription: Studies of the creature have revealed extraordinary properties in its internal organs: they consume, store, and convert energy with remarkable efficiency. The research has since given rise to the idea of a new Energy Building.

nodes.name: Allergy Season
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: in the open sea, Behemoth
nodes.spawnConditions: in the open sea, Behemoth
nodes.eventDescription: During the shift, a commonly used reagent in production was found to act as an irritant, leading several crew members to develop allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing, itching, and watery eyes. The affected crew members report discomfort, and production pace slows as safety checks and substitutions are considered.

inactionThreat.description: No solution, everyone sneezing
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The effects of the irritant intensified, and symptoms escalated into widespread malaise. The crew is left feeling unwell and uncomfortable, with persistent itching affecting everyone.

penalties.name: Weakened Health II
penalties.comments: The crew's HP maximum is reduced by a percentile. The missing amount of health is reduced first.

actions.description: Prepare and distribute a suitable remedy to relieve crew members’ irritation symptoms.
actions.resultDescription: The remedy proved highly effective among the crew, not only alleviating irritation symptoms but also providing a noticeable boost to overall well-being.

rewards.name: Health Recovery
rewards.effect: gain 5 HP per hour for 48 hours
rewards.comments: Affected crewmembers regain missing HP at the rate of 5HP per hour.

actions.description: Inspect and replace air filters in the affected factory area to reduce exposure to the irritant.
actions.resultDescription: Inspection revealed that faulty filters were the source of the problem. With repairs completed, crew symptoms have drastically diminished, and as an added benefit, the risk of disease transmission has been reduced.

rewards.name: Boosted Immunity I
rewards.comments: Affected cremember's Immunity is Increased by 50% (rounded up)

actions.description: Provide proper containers so the crew can safely collect, inspect, and research the irritant to develop an effective solution.
actions.resultDescription: The crew successfully adjusted the reagent formula to lessen its irritating effects. Additionally, several members gained valuable hands-on experience, leading to new specializations within the team.

nodes.name: Light Backlog
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: in the open sea
nodes.spawnConditions: in the open sea
nodes.eventDescription: For the first time in days the board is clean and pressure is low. Tools are staged, crews are on shift, and we have a short window to either pull work forward, invest in people, or clear the small blockers that usually slow the first hour of a surge.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The lull passes without a plan. Although everything seems fine now, the first hour of the next surge is slowed by missing approvals, labels, and tool checks that could have been addressed earlier. The crew face the same friction as before, and the chance to build momentum is missed.

penalties.name: Productivity Slowdown I
penalties.comments: Buildings' or crew's  productivity is reduced by 20 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: Use spare time to plan for the next rush, ensuring maximum efficiency.
actions.resultDescription: The crew have planned out the next hours and are now able to address upcoming situations more efficiently, resulting in a spike in overall productivity.

rewards.name: Boosted Productivity II
rewards.comments: Buildings' or crew's productivity is increased by 50 for duration fo effect.

actions.description: Use available time to run a group workshop focused on long-term crew preparedness.
actions.resultDescription: Some crew members used this time to deepen their understanding of logistics, becoming more specialized in their roles and enabling smoother, more efficient task execution for everyone.

nodes.name: Stowaway Fauna
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.eventIntro: This place seems perfect for releasing the Plumplins. Take a closer look at it first.
nodes.eventDescription: Although our knowledge of these owl-like creatures is limited, observations suggest the island has everything they need. We can send a team ashore to find the right spot and help them settle in.

actions.description: Survey the island for the best spot, release the Plumplins there, and stay long enough to see how they settle.
actions.resultDescription: The Plumplins took to the prepared nesting site at once and settled in, healthy and content. Over the following days they grew attached to the crew, and when it came time to part ways, they left something from the nest behind. The crew chose to read it as a thank-you.

actions.description: Release the Plumplins on the island and leave them to it — the habitat looks safe, and they'll adapt.
actions.resultDescription: With bittersweet emotions, the crew released the adorable creatures into the wild, confident that the island will provide them a new home. Though farewells were teary, the crew felt joy knowing the Plumplins were safe and free, ready to embrace their new life.
